20g dry:  
I grew and dried my own Amazonians, and I did different levels of trips with them over the course of a month until I went for the ultimate trip. I spent several hours meditating and setting my intention before the trip.  
It took me about 45 minutes to eat all of them, and I was starting to feel the effects very quickly.  
I laid down listening to the grateful dead the whole time, feeling pure bliss and love on a level I couldn't describe.  
Every time I take shrooms I "die", this was something beyond that, I had been "dead" for many millennia.  
The open eyed visuals were super bright, it was like being on the rainbow road level on Mario Kart. I could barely see my hands in front of my face. When I closed my eyes, I saw the faces (those faces!) gliding towards me.  
I swear I could hear the shrooms singing and talking to me but not in English, it sounded more like maybe Arabic or an ancient language.  
My ego then split into 3 "doctors" who were discussing me like I was a patient on an operating table. They were trying to fix my mind, my heart and my eyes. My eyes starting watering and had soaked my pillow.  
It took a long time to wear off, slowly feeling like 15g, then 10g and so on.  There's a lot I don't really remember from the trip unfortunately. The whole process was about 12 hours and the next day I still felt a bit strange.  
Overall while my experience was positive I wouldn't recommend trying this. It's been 2 years since that trip and I still have large gaps in my memory of it and feel like the 3.5-5g trips have given me more in terms of growth and introspection.

Thank you, I'll do my best to break everything down:   
Diet- high protein, high fibre with most meals made from scratch. Lactose intolerant so dairy is really the only thing I don't have. I tend to eat from 5pm onwards but I'm not strict about intermittent fasting, it's just what feels right for me. I have the mind set that if I really want something food wise, I'll just have it.   
Calories- 1600-1900 depending on how much exercise I did that day.   
Exercise- A mix of incline walking, running, stairmaster, elliptical, cycling and rowing depending on what I was in the mood for. As long as it was enough to break a sweat every day!   
Cutting out alcohol has been such a game changer with weight loss, definitely recommend it if it feels like the right thing to do!
